step: Goal 1 Step B; proxy tasks only, never IM vs non-IM

datasets.A2-NBI: PRIMARY. 2018-2021; exact within-patient duplicates removed; images with p_wli < threshold; patients with >= 3 such images; at most 10 images per patient. IM&CG vs LGIN+HGIN+EGC.
datasets.S1: Sensitivity. 2018-2021; duplicates removed; no modality filter; at most 10 images per patient. IM&CG vs LGIN+HGIN+EGC.
datasets.S2: Sensitivity. S1 without LGIN (same drawn images). IM&CG vs HGIN+EGC.
datasets.S3: Sensitivity. A2-NBI without LGIN (same drawn images). IM&CG vs HGIN+EGC. Added before any evaluation after review of residual dye/forceps/white-light in LGIN.

modality_filter.description: colour LR, WLI vs non-WLI, threshold = Youden J on out-of-fold predictions against visual modality labels only. Removes white-light-looking images; it does not remove non-magnified NBI or dye.

preprocessing: resize the FULL image to 224x224 (bicubic), no center-crop, no custom crop; model-specific normalisation; embeddings L2-normalised per image

embeddings.device: CPU fp32 batch 8 (user decision 2026-11-05: .venv torch has no CUDA)

logistic_regression.standardisation: StandardScaler fit on the training rows of each fold
logistic_regression.C_selection: inner 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on patient-level AUC (mean image probability); ties -> smallest C
logistic_regression.threshold: Youden J on inner-CV patient-level out-of-fold probabilities for the selected C

cv.splitter: StratifiedGroupKFold on image rows, groups = patient

metrics.primary: patient-level AUC, pooled over patients per repeat, mean over repeats
metrics.also: balanced accuracy at inner-CV threshold; mean per-fold AUC
metrics.subgroups: IM&CG vs each negative class; per year (descriptive, no retraining)

bootstrap.unit: patients, stratified by class; each draw evaluated on all repeats

paired_comparison: bootstrap difference against the best shortcut of the same dataset on the same folds; best = highest AUC over groups and LR/RF, which favours the shortcut

shortcuts.models: LR with the same protocol; RF untuned

permutation.what: shuffle patient labels and repeat the WHOLE pipeline (all repeats, outer folds, inner CV)

stop_conditions.others: label/modality leakage, NaNs, class empty in a fold

untouched: D:/dataset_gim/foroutan_new is an independent test set and is not used
